visual_elements.description: Scatter plot of iris dataset projected onto two components. X-axis labeled Z₁ (dark-red #8B0000 italic), ticks at -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. Y-axis labeled Z₂ (dark-red #8B0000 italic), ticks at -1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5. Three clusters: orange (#E8720C) points (Setosa) clustered around x≈-2.7, y≈0.2 inside a vertical yellow (#F5E625) ellipse spanning roughly x -3.4 to -2.0, y -1.1 to 1.5; green (#3D9970) points (Versicolor) centered around x≈1.0, y≈0.0; blue (#2E2EB8) points (Virginica) centered around x≈2.2, y≈0.3. A large light-blue (#A9C6E8) ellipse encloses the green+blue points, tilted positively, spanning roughly x -1.2 to 4.2, y -1.3 to 1.5. A small cursor arrow is visible near (3.0, 0.6).
Thin dark-red (#8B0000) rectangular border enclosing the scatter plot area; a matching dark-red border also frames the entire slide edge.

recreation_brief: 1. Set the full slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8) and add no title or subtitle text (the source slide displays none). 2. Draw the outer border: one thin dark-red (#8B0000) rectangle outline running along the slide perimeter, slightly inset from all four slide edges (exact inset not specified; use a minimal uniform inset). 3. Draw the inner border: one thin dark-red (#8B0000) rectangle outline enclosing the scatter plot area at approximately x 25-78%, y 17-90% of the slide. 4. Create one XY scatter chart (dots only, no connecting lines, no chart title) occupying approximately x 25-75%, y 18-88% of the slide, on the gray background. 5. Add the x-axis: label 'Z₁' (Z with subscript 1) in italic dark red (#8B0000) below the horizontal axis, with tick labels -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 in small black sans-serif text. 6. Add the y-axis: label 'Z₂' (Z with subscript 2) in italic dark red (#8B0000) beside the vertical axis, with tick labels -1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 in small black sans-serif text. 7. Plot the Setosa series: orange (#E8720C) dots forming one compact cluster centered at approximately (-2.7, 0.2), contained within x -3.4 to -2.0 and y -1.1 to 1.5 (exact point count not specified). 8. Plot the Versicolor series: green (#3D9970) dots forming one cluster centered at approximately (1.0, 0.0). 9. Plot the Virginica series: blue (#2E2EB8) dots forming one cluster centered at approximately (2.2, 0.3). 10. Draw the Setosa ellipse: one vertical yellow (#F5E625) ellipse around the orange cluster, spanning approximately x -3.4 to -2.0 and y -1.1 to 1.5 (fill vs outline style not specified). 11. Draw the combined ellipse: one large light-blue (#A9C6E8) ellipse tilted with a positive slope, enclosing the green and blue clusters, spanning approximately x -1.2 to 4.2 and y -1.3 to 1.5. 12. Add the legend at approximately x 82-92%, y 38-48% (right of the plot, outside the inner border): three sans-serif lines stacked vertically reading 'Setosa' in orange (#E8720C), 'Versicolor' in green (#3D9970), and 'Virginica' in blue (#2E2EB8). 13. Add the slide-number badge at approximately x 90-94%, y 10-16% (top-right corner, outside the inner border): one yellow (#F5E625) circle with a thin black (#000000) outline containing the black number '38'. 14. Fidelity option: add one small mouse-cursor arrow inside the plot near data coordinate (3.0, 0.6), over the blue Virginica cluster; this is a screen-capture pointer, not slide content — include only if exact frame fidelity is required.
